2026-10-09.headline: GPT-6 rolls out in ChatGPT with Intelligent UI, Claude Haiku 5.5 launches, and GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast arrives on Amazon Bedrock.

bullets.text: GPT-6 is rolling out globally in ChatGPT with Intelligent UI, adding visuals and interactive experiences you can use directly.
Anthropic introduced Claude Haiku 5.5 as the cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model it has released.
Ultrafast mode for GPT-6.1 Sol is on Amazon Bedrock for workloads where faster inference matters most.
Claude Haiku 5.5 is on Amazon Bedrock and Claude Platform on AWS for subagents and high-volume work.
Sophos uses OpenAI Daybreak to cut threat investigation time by 96% and automate 52% of MDR cases.
Google DeepMind opened Playground, an experimental platform to create, play, and share custom games.
